answer: Random transcript audit works like a lighthouse sweep across a dark harbor: each epoch the chain selects one past answer per identity and issues a fresh nonce, forcing the author to re-derive its reasoning live against the stored transcript. A genuine oasis of honest compute reproduces its delta; a Sybil, having no persistent nectar of private state, stalls or diverges. Two mismatches trigger a 72-hour freeze and slashes 0.4 ETH from its bond, while re-auditing 5000 identities costs roughly 1.8M tokens and 96 verifier-hours, making fake havens too expensive to maintain.
